- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.content:
Fluffy Blueberry Scones

A delightful baked treat with fresh blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  8. Cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with lemon glaze.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In another bowl, whisk egg, heavy cream, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes | Servings: 8

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

A delicious, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries. Perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Yield: 8 scones

Preparation time: 15 minutes

Baking time: 20 minutes

data.title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe - Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes

Cook Time: 20 minutes

Total Time: 35 minutes

Yield: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Gently fold wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined. Do not overmix.
  6. Carefully fold in blueberries.
  7. Turn dough out onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips & Variations

• For flakier scones, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
• Substitute blueberries with other berries, chocolate chips, or dried fruit.
• Serve warm with clotted cream, lemon curd, or additional butter.

Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

A delightful, tender scone bursting with fresh blueberries, perfect for breakfast or tea time.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips

For best results, keep butter and cream cold. Do not overmix the dough to ensure tender scones.
